Great Team and fantastic Service! Highly Recommended!

text:
I visited this clinic around 10 times and was a regular customer. Unfortunately, I missed my last two appointments due to personal circumstances — things like this happen in real life.

When I called to reschedule, I initially spoke with a manager, but then the owner took the phone and started accusing me of missing appointments in a very unprofessional manner. Instead of understanding or offering a solution, I was met with a rude attitude.

If you are willing to argue with a regular client over 1300 baht, it says a lot about your priorities. Yes, sometimes people are late or need to reschedule — that’s normal. However, not once did anyone say “thank you” for the many times I showed up on time and supported your business.

Your services are decent, but I cannot say the pricing feels justified for what is offered. Also, this is not the first negative interaction — my wife was treated rudely by your staff before as well.

It’s disappointing to see a business lose a loyal customer over such behavior.
